findings.evidence: users-manage-mobile-light/dark: sheet top y=430 cuts the first record's Manage invoker (y=397-437) by ~7px. Live (Chrome154/DPR2, 390x844): .row-actions-menu is position:fixed, inset 430/16/16/16, ::backdrop transparent; for the second record the 40px invoker (y=647-687) is fully covered.
findings.effect: Below 52rem the menu is a viewport-bottom sheet without a scrim or the account name, so it covers its own invoker and the user cannot see which record it acts on, except by memory.
findings.fix: Smallest change: show the account name as the sheet's first line (text from the row, no new data) and give the open popover a ::backdrop scrim; alternatively anchor it under the invoker as on desktop. Keep native popover, one-open, Escape/outside dismissal, authorization and step-up unchanged.

findings.evidence: Stills show an accent-bordered search field on arrival; live document.activeElement is #group-search. Source: AdminGroups.tsx:128 autoFocus (pre-existing since 215f937), while App connections leaves focus on body.
findings.effect: On a zero-item list the focused search, not Create group, is the visual focus; on phones it can raise the keyboard.
findings.fix: Drop autoFocus on the list search (the view already focuses its heading at line 21).

verdict.reason: My own quality mean over the 36 stage-02 originals is 116/15 = 7.7333 (half-up 7.7), below 8.0 on my scale, so I do not report satisfaction. Every round-1 major finding is resolved on screen and live; what remains is one bounded phone row-action finding and optional polish. I do not ask for another round only to chase points. Progression is the parent's combined Claude/Sol decision, and this individual shortfall is not a veto.
